metadata.name: rxtrail
metadata.description: RxTrail: tamper-proof dispensing limits for controlled prescriptions, on Solana.

instructions.name: cancel_prescription
docs: The issuing prescriber cancels a prescription nobody dispensed yet.

accounts.name: prescriber
docs: The prescription's prescriber must still be active: a suspended
prescriber's prescriptions stop being dispensable.

accounts.name: medication
docs: The prescribed medication: a withdrawn one freezes its prescriptions.

accounts.name: prescribed_product
docs: The locked product, if any: it must be a version of `medication`.

instructions.name: set_dispenser_status
docs: Suspend or reinstate a dispenser (health authority only).

instructions.name: set_medication_status
docs: Withdraw (recall) or reinstate a medication (catalog authority only).

instructions.name: set_prescriber_status
docs: Suspend or reinstate a prescriber (professional authority only).

instructions.name: set_product_status
docs: Withdraw (recall) or reinstate a product (catalog authority only).

instructions.name: stop_prescription
docs: The issuing prescriber stops a partly dispensed prescription: what
remains can no longer be dispensed.

errors.name: NotProfessionalAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the professional authority

errors.name: NotHealthAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the health authority

errors.name: InvalidQuantity
errors.msg: Quantity must be greater than zero

errors.name: ExpiryInThePast
errors.msg: Expiry must be in the future

errors.name: QuantityExceedsRemaining
errors.msg: Quantity exceeds what remains on the prescription

errors.name: NotCatalogAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the catalog authority

errors.name: MedicationNotActive
errors.msg: Medication is withdrawn from the catalog

errors.name: ProductNotActive
errors.msg: Product is withdrawn from the catalog

errors.name: ProductMedicationMismatch
errors.msg: Product is not a version of the prescribed medication

errors.name: PrescribedProductMismatch
errors.msg: The prescriber locked another product: substitution not allowed

errors.name: NotPrescriptionIssuer
errors.msg: Only the prescriber who issued the prescription may close it

errors.name: AlreadyDispensed
errors.msg: Already dispensed: it can no longer be cancelled, only stopped

errors.name: NothingDispensed
errors.msg: Nothing dispensed yet: cancel the prescription instead

fields.name: entry
docs: The medication or product account.

fields.name: is_medication
docs: True for a medication, false for a product.

types.name: ClosureReason
docs: Why a prescription was closed. Non-clinical categories on purpose: this is
public, and a clinical reason would be health data. Details stay off-chain.

types.name: Config
docs: Who may enable participants. Set once, at initialization.

fields.name: professional_authority
docs: Enables prescribers (e.g. a medical council).

fields.name: health_authority
docs: Enables dispensers (e.g. a health regulator).

fields.name: catalog_authority
docs: Registers and withdraws medications and products (e.g. a drug regulator).

types.name: Dispensation
docs: One dispensation event. Created once; no instruction ever modifies it.

fields.name: index
docs: Position in the prescription's history: 0, 1, 2, ...

fields.name: dispenser
docs: Key of the dispenser who signed it.

fields.name: product
docs: The product handed out (its account address).

fields.name: remaining_after
docs: Remaining quantity right after this dispensation.

types.name: Dispenser
docs: A dispenser (pharmacy) enabled by the health authority.

fields.name: key
docs: The dispenser's own key: the one that must sign its dispensations.

fields.name: status_changed_at
docs: When the status last changed (registration, suspension, reinstatement).

types.name: Medication
docs: A medication in the catalog: an active ingredient, strength and form
(e.g. clonazepam 2 mg tablet). What a prescriber prescribes.

fields.name: id
docs: Random id; also the PDA seed.

fields.name: identity_hash
docs: sha256 of the fields that define the medication, as published in the
off-chain catalog. Written once: the meaning of this record can never
be rewritten, while names and guidance stay off-chain.

fields.name: status_changed_at
docs: When the status last changed (registration, withdrawal, reinstatement).

fields.name: participant
docs: The participant's own key.

fields.name: is_prescriber
docs: True for a prescriber, false for a dispenser.

types.name: Prescriber
docs: A prescriber enabled by the professional authority.

fields.name: key
docs: The prescriber's own key: the one that must sign their prescriptions.

fields.name: status_changed_at
docs: When the status last changed (registration, suspension, reinstatement).

types.name: Prescription
docs: A prescription for a controlled medication.
Created once and never rewritten: only the counters move, and only through
`dispense`. Each dispensation is its own immutable account.

fields.name: id
docs: Random id; also the PDA seed.

fields.name: prescriber
docs: Key of the prescriber who signed it.

fields.name: medication
docs: The catalog medication prescribed (its account address).

fields.name: document_hash
docs: Salted hash of the full off-chain prescription document: proves the
document was not altered after issuance, without revealing it.

fields.name: dispensation_count
docs: Number of dispensations so far; also the seed of the next one.

fields.name: prescribed_product
docs: Set when the prescriber locked a product ("do not substitute"): only
that one may be dispensed. Last, so the fixed-size fields before it keep
fixed offsets for filtered queries.

types.name: PrescriptionClosure
docs: The prescriber's act of cancelling or stopping a prescription. One per
prescription (closing is final); created once, never modified.

fields.name: prescriber
docs: Key of the prescriber who signed it.

fields.name: quantity_dispensed
docs: Dispensed before the closure (0 when cancelled).

fields.name: quantity_voided
docs: What the closure voided: the remaining balance.

types.name: Product
docs: A medication as one manufacturer makes it: the box a pharmacy hands out.

fields.name: id
docs: Random id; also the PDA seed.

fields.name: medication
docs: The medication this product is a version of.

fields.name: identity_hash
docs: sha256 of the fields that define the product (medication, manufacturer,
brand, kind). Written once.
